get_a_point_set: generate n well-distributed normalized points of a given shape using a specified or random method
quasi_randomize: re-randomize an existing point set using a dispersion method while preserving original norms
normalize: normalize a list of numpy arrays to unit L2 norm along each element
parallel_create_statistics: benchmark all point generation methods against multiple metrics in parallel and save heatmaps
manual_avg_pool3d: apply 3D average pooling to a numpy array with a specified kernel size
